purpose: Frozen regression baseline AFTER the pricing corrections of step 7. Any later change must reproduce these price columns exactly unless it is explicitly approved as a pricing-semantics change.

fixed_environment.RMS_REPORT_KEEP: default 3 (retention skipped because an override is active)

step_7_rules.name: pace ratio stops inventing a denominator
step_7_rules.before: Hist_OTB = max(1, raw) made Pace_Ratio equal the OTB room count
step_7_rules.after: raw history count is published; no history -> ratio 1.0, basis 'no_history'

step_7_rules.name: one occupancy per row
step_7_rules.before: day 0 displayed the live 80% but priced on an OTB-derived 0%
step_7_rules.after: Current_Occupancy is the only occupancy; Effective_Occupancy equals it

step_7_rules.name: whole-unit rate inside its own band
step_7_rules.before: clip then bank round published 94.0 against a 94.5 floor
step_7_rules.after: round half up, then clamp to [ceil(MIN), floor(MAX)]; guard tolerance 0

step_7_rules.name: guest density is a same-day signal
step_7_rules.before: today's guests-per-room repriced all 180 future dates when occupancy was high

step_7_rules.name: dirty PMS rows cannot kill a cycle
step_7_rules.before: an unparsable date raised outside the try block; the stay-night loop was unbounded
step_7_rules.after: rms_core.reservations drops and names bad rows, caps a stay at 365 nights

reconciliation.result: undoing R1-R4 reproduces every v0 Recommended_ADR and Final_ADR exactly

notes: v0 remains on disk as the pre-correction reference; the gate uses v7.
Prices are frozen per baseline series; do not compare across different AS_OF_DATE values.
The demo feed has history for only 4 of 180 rows, so R1 dominates the v0 -> v7 delta.
